hints.title: Subarray Divisibility Property
hints.text: Every element in a valid subarray must divide k evenly. Any element that does not divide k invalidates all subarrays containing it.

hints.title: Incremental Least Common Multiple
hints.text: Fix the left boundary i. Incrementally expand right boundary j while maintaining the least common multiple of elements seen so far.

hints.title: Early Termination Condition
hints.text: If the running least common multiple exceeds k or fails to divide k, break the inner loop early.

hints.title: Iterative LCM Computation Implementation

complexity.notes: Given n <= 1000, quadratic iteration with fast Euclidean GCD/LCM executes within milliseconds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing the entire subarray least common multiple from scratch takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running least common multiple iteratively and prunes invalid bounds.
